entities.summary: Sasha Mikhailovna Antonova, known professionally as Sasha Gradiva, is a Russian-born American singer, songwriter, producer, and performing artist. Her music is a blend of pop dance with infusions of electronica. She began her professional career at the age of 16, and has gained recognition within the European music scene, on MTV and in the Russian music industry.
